mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening supply-side conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.25% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls simultaneously and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) combined with a rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines and UNRATE rises simultaneously and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in one month signals a shift towards restrictive policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases > 0.25% during a tightening cycle and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
